dropzones.name: Erden Airfield
dropzones.status_evidence: The organiser bulletin puts the 60th Bulgarian Championship / EEAL round at Dropzone Erden (N43 29.955 E23 18.281, matching the record) on 4-7 Sep 2025 with Cessna and An-2 jump aircraft and pre-event training from 29 Aug. The EEAL results file (created 14 Sep 2025) and a Ministry of Defence report dated 11 Sep 2025 confirm the jumps took place on 5-6 Sep. Caveat: in 2026 the national championship moved to Dolna Mitropolia and the Bulgarian EEAL round to Pleven, 'for the first time' away from Montana, so no 2026 jumping at Erden is confirmed. Erden tandems in 2026 appear only on gift resellers, which do not count.
